newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: ACACIA BOOKS PROFIT ON ZINC PROJECT SALE.
newsitem.headline: ACACIA BOOKS PROFIT ON ZINC PROJECT SALE.

text.p: Acacia Resources Ltd said on Thursday it booked an abnormal profit after tax of A$15.2 million from the sale of Blendevale zinc-lead project in Western Australia to Western Metals Ltd.
Acacia earlier reported a net profit of A$20.12 million for the six months ended June 30, 1997, up from A$7.50 million a year earlier.
The gold miner said the abnormal profit was partly offset by a A$2.2 million expense from reorganising power supply arrangements for Pine Creek gold operations in the Northern Territory.

Acacia said the abnormal profit was also partially offset by the A$4.2 million write-down of carrying values of remaininng base metal exploration interests and the A$1.7 million loss on the Mount Fitch joint venture disposal.
